# hpe_opsramp_scheduled_maintenance (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp Scheduled Maintenance Window. Supports one-time and recurring schedules with device, device group, and location targeting.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A description of the maintenance window.
- `name` (String) The name of the scheduled maintenance window.
- `schedule` (Attributes) The schedule timing configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))

### Optional

- `alert_conditions` (Attributes) Alert conditions to filter which alerts are suppressed during maintenance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_conditions))
- `client` (String) The unique ID of the client (sub-tenant). If not provided, uses the provider's tenant.
- `correlate_alerts` (Boolean) Enable alert correlation during maintenance.
- `device_group_ids` (Set of String) Device group IDs to include in the maintenance window.
- `device_ids` (Set of String) Device IDs to include in the maintenance window.
- `install_patch` (Boolean) Install patches during maintenance.
- `notify_before_end_time` (Number) Number of minutes to notify users before maintenance ends.
- `notify_before_start_time` (Number) Number of minutes to notify users before maintenance starts.
- `run_escalate_action` (Boolean) Enable escalation policy during maintenance.
- `run_rba` (Boolean) Enable run book automation during maintenance.
- `site_ids` (Set of String) Site IDs to include in the maintenance window.
- `user_group_ids` (Set of String) User group IDs to notify about the maintenance window.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) User IDs to notify about the maintenance window.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the maintenance window (e.g. SM-...).
- `status` (String) The current status of the maintenance window (Active, Pending, Completed, Suspended).

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `end_time` (String) The end time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2026-06-10T18:00:00+0200`).
- `start_time` (String) The start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2026-06-10T17:00:00+0200`).
- `timezone` (String) The timezone for the schedule (e.g. `America/New_York`, `GMT`, `UTC`).
- `type` (String) The schedule type (`one-time` or `recurring`).

Optional:

- `end_by` (String) When the recurring schedule ends. Use `Never` for no end date, or a datetime in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2026-12-31T23:59:59+0000`).
- `pattern` (Attributes) The recurrence pattern. Required when schedule type is `Recurring`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule--pattern))

<a id="nestedatt--schedule--pattern"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule.pattern`

Required:

- `type` (String) The pattern type (`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` or `yearly`).

Optional:

- `day_frequency` (String) For monthly pattern, the day of the month (e.g. `15`) or a descriptor like `everyday`.
- `day_of_month` (String) For monthly pattern, the day of the month (e.g. `15`) or a descriptor like `LastDay`.
- `day_of_week` (String) For monthly pattern, the day of the week (e.g. `Monday`).
- `months` (String) For yearly pattern, comma-separated months (e.g. `January,June`).
- `repeat_frecuency` (Number) The repeat frequency for the pattern. For daily, how many days between occurrences; for weekly, how many weeks between occurrences; for monthly, how many months between occurrences.
- `week_days` (String) Comma-separated days for weekly pattern (e.g. `Monday,Wednesday,Friday`).
- `week_index` (String) For monthly pattern, the week index (e.g. `First`, `Second`, `Third`, `Fourth`, `Last`).



<a id="nestedatt--alert_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_conditions`

Required:

- `matching_type` (String) How rules are combined (`ANY` or `ALL`).
- `rules` (Attributes List) Alert condition rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_conditions--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--alert_conditions--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_conditions.rules`

Required:

- `key` (String) The alert field to match (e.g. `subject`, `description`, `serviceName`, `resourceName`).
- `operator` (String) The comparison operator (e.g. `CONTAINS`, `EQUALS`).
- `value` (String) The value to match against.
